compiled_state.title: GREEN: wire inference-recall-replay.sh into test index and validate SC4 gate against real corpus
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Wire inference-recall-replay.sh into the project test index (.test-index) so it is tracked for coverage, and run the SC4 closure gate against the real incidents.jsonl corpus from S1 (893a-d0d3) to establish baseline metrics.

## Why
The story done definitions require: 'replay against incidents.jsonl shows inference challenge recall >= 50% of all incidents.' This task is the final closure validation step that confirms the harness works end-to-end with the real corpus (not just synthetic fixtures).

## Steps
1. Add entry to .test-index: tests/test-inference-recall-replay.sh → plugins/dso/scripts/inference-recall-replay.sh
2. Run inference-recall-replay.sh against tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/incidents.jsonl (requires S1 corpus to be available)
3. Verify RECALL_RESULT signal is emitted with all_passed: true
4. If any threshold fails, document the failure in a ticket comment (this task DOES NOT fix corpus quality — that is S1's responsibility)

## Dependencies
- Requires 893a-d0d3 (S1) tasks T4 (inference-incident-curator agent) and T6a/T6b (incidents.jsonl + holdout.txt) to be complete
- Requires 18b0-7c5d (S3) affects_fields classifier to be available for non-stub run

## Note on ordering
If S3 classifier is not yet available, run the harness in --dry-run mode (uses affects_fields directly from incident record). Document the mode used in a ticket comment on 1c7b-74a6.

## AC
- .test-index has mapping for inference-recall-replay.sh
- RECALL_RESULT signal shows all_passed: true (or failure documented in ticket comment)
- Ticket comment added to 1c7b-74a6 recording the baseline metrics observed
